title: Who Holds the Compute
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (studies 65-66): four interactive figures drawn by script with no library; numbers from analyse65.py and analyse66.py
embodies: Five companies hold about 69 % (90 %: 63-73 %) of the AI chip compute the open record counts at the end of 2025, flat for two quarters; the newest published 75.8 % rests on an unfinished quarter; the record has no category for states and counts ownership, not use. The use record crosses it: OpenAI and Anthropic own none of the counted chips but have published commitments of at least $590 billion to nine providers; xAI, an owner, rents its chips to Anthropic; only 3 of 19 published agreements state a number of chips, none in H100-equivalents.
